scraped.scraped_description: An easy tool to host a quadratic vote

name: RxC Quadratic Voting
tagline: An easy tool to host a quadratic vote. Quadratic Voting is the mathematically optimal way to vote in a democratic community by allocating votes that express the degree of your preferences, not just direction.
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Relies on volunteer maintenance; limited dedicated funding for long-term sustainability
policy_outcomes: Adopted by several DAOs for resource allocation
documented_limitations: Limited empirical evidence on large-scale electoral use
Voter education required for quadratic voting mechanics
failure_modes: Low adoption in traditional government elections
curation_criteria: Open contribution model with community review; decisions made by Radical Exchange core team
political_relevance_summary: RxC Quadratic Voting addresses democratic participation and citizen engagement. An easy tool to host a quadratic vote. Quadratic Voting is the mathematically optimal way to vote in a democratic community by allocating votes that express the degree of your preferences, not just direction.

movement_building_utility.notes: Directly supports organizing, mobilization, or democratic participation processes.

generalizability_notes: Open-source codebase facilitates replication; already deployed across multiple jurisdictions; replication materials are available.
